literal_source_claim_zh: 非一致双曲系统的工具
literal_source_claim_en: A tool for nonuniformly hyperbolic systems.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not choose whether the target is the tower/Markov-extension construction, existence of an SRB measure, exponential correlation decay, a central limit theorem, an application to one example class, or a later theorem about systems modeled by a Young tower. It also supplies none of the product-structure, return-time, distortion, tail, aperiodicity, observable, or conclusion data needed by those inequivalent propositions.
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix the phase space and universe, discrete map and regularity, invariant hyperbolic-product set, stable and unstable families, partition branches, return-time function, separation-time and distortion data, reference and invariant measures, and observable codomains.
conclusion: Open: the repository states no truth-valued conclusion. Young 1998 separately gives an SRB-measure existence result, exponential correlation decay, and a central limit theorem, while the tower itself is a construction rather than one of those conclusions.
candidate_scope_not_credited: the Markov extension Delta over a source-specified return map under a positive integer-valued return-time function
Young 1998 Theorem 1: integrability of the return time implies existence of an SRB measure under P1-P5
Young 1998 Theorem 2: an exponential return-time tail plus total ergodicity implies exponential decay of correlations
Young 1998 Theorem 3: under Theorem 2 hypotheses, centered Holder observables satisfy a central limit theorem with a coboundary criterion
one of Young 1998's example theorems for Axiom A systems, piecewise hyperbolic maps, billiards, logistic maps, or Henon-type attractors
a later abstract theorem for systems admitting a Young or Gibbs-Markov tower with polynomial, stretched-exponential, or exponential tails
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: empty or null base and empty branch family
zero return time versus strictly positive return times and finite versus infinite return
nonintegrable return time and finite versus infinite lifted measure
noninvertible or singular maps versus the diffeomorphism setting of Part I
failure of aperiodicity or total ergodicity and periodic tower components
zero or nonexponential return-time tails and the precise decay-rate convention
constant observables, noncentered observables, zero variance, and the exact coboundary space
projection multiplicity and points outside the tower-covered invariant set
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-1409 Kakutani tower or THM-M-1410 Rokhlin tower
THM-M-1415 Markov partitions or a finite-state symbolic coding theorem
THM-M-1417 SRB measure as a general notion or an unrelated existence theorem
THM-M-1420 Pesin theory or THM-M-1421 the Pesin entropy formula
a bare definition of a sigma type or structure carrying all desired properties as fields
a tautological theorem whose assumptions already contain the requested conclusion
a numerical simulation, finite-time correlation estimate, or generated return-time histogram

primary_source_candidates.citation: Lai-Sang Young, Statistical Properties of Dynamical Systems with Some Hyperbolicity, Annals of Mathematics 147(3) (1998), 585-650, DOI 10.2307/120960
Lai-Sang Young, Recurrence Times and Rates of Mixing, Israel Journal of Mathematics 110 (1999), 153-188, DOI 10.1007/BF02808180

tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact imports, terminal declarations, transitive dependency closure, executables, and trust policy remain open
computation_profile: No simulation, numerical correlation estimate, generated return-time data, oracle, or unchecked certificate is credited
formal_system: Lean 4 + pinned mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source or target correction, selected source theorem, tower and return-time model, hypotheses, conclusion, boundary decisions, Lean target, toolchain or dependency pin, assurance profile, or validator change; independent reviewers and review due date remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. H5 classifies the supplied construction label and tool gloss as not yet a stable proposition; it does not refute Young towers or Young's published theorems. The API probe supplies no target statement or proof credit. No H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, theorem completion, or master acceptance is claimed.
